menstruation.name: Menstrual phase
menstruation.headline: At this point in the cycle, many women feel real physical fatigue and lower tolerance for noise or demands.
observable: Her physical state: fatigue, sensitivity to smells or bright lights
Her pace: a likely need to slow down
Her household logistics: what she usually takes care of
propose: Step in without asking "can I help?" — decide, act
Lighten the household load (meals, groceries, kids)
Offer quiet time: no loud evening imposed on her
avoid: Making packed social plans without talking to her first
Asking her to settle a substantial logistical matter
Mentioning her period in front of others

post_menstrual.name: Post-menstrual phase
post_menstrual.range: A few days after the period
post_menstrual.headline: At this point in the cycle, many women regain steady energy, still low, without euphoria. Recovery is underway.
observable: A stable mood, more open to conversation
Desires re-emerging (projects, conversations put off until later)
propose: Pick back up the conversations she left on pause
Ask her where she stands, without rushing her
avoid: Imposing an intense pace on her right away
Reviving an unresolved conflict the moment energy returns
Mistaking returning energy for full energy

pre_ovulatory.name: Pre-ovulatory phase
pre_ovulatory.headline: At this point in the cycle, many women feel a rise in energy, a drive to take things on, and greater tolerance for risk.
observable: An appetite for projects, outings, encounters
A steadier voice, a more direct gaze
propose: Start a project, an outing, a short trip with her
Leave her room to carry her own momentum
Be present physically and in listening to her ideas
avoid: Cutting her momentum short out of excess caution
Constantly bringing the conversation back to daily routine
Mistaking her energy for a request for coaching

ovulation.name: Ovulatory phase
ovulation.range: Fertile window, 5 days centered on day (L-14)
ovulation.headline: At this point in the cycle, many women experience a peak in confidence, sociability, and physical openness.
observable: Attention to the body, to appearance, to how she's seen
An appetite for flirtation and play
propose: Give her one-on-one time, with no agenda
Seize the light moments, the laughter, the sensuality
Tell her what you notice in her, without calculation
avoid: Mistaking her radiance for an invitation to everyone
Reducing this phase to fertility alone

post_ovulatory.name: Post-ovulatory phase
post_ovulatory.headline: At this point in the cycle, many women experience a stable plateau, well suited to productivity and refocusing.
observable: Attention to structure, sorting, what needs finishing
A gradual decline in social drive
propose: Move forward on concrete things with her: decisions, paperwork, home
Respect her moments of withdrawal without reading into them
Keep your commitments, even small ones
avoid: Launching yet another vague or hypothetical project
Taking up an excess of her time for yourself
Reading withdrawal as a personal distancing

pre_menstrual.name: Pre-menstrual phase
pre_menstrual.headline: At this point in the cycle, many women have a more demanding, sometimes darker outlook, along with great creativity.
propose: Lighten the logistics without making a show of it
Give her time alone if she wants it
Don't argue against criticism head-on — listen, reflect it back
avoid: Asking her to settle a weighty decision today
